main_text.l: circumveni: Et cur insulsam illam ac turbulentam multitudinem elusisse, crimini sit? Repagulum ponimus, dum scitè imponimus: frænum & flagellum sunt illi, quos suggerimus, instinctus: apprehendat hos prudens rector, utatur his: & domet, & agat, quo vult, debili Rationi, vanis legibus obtuentem semper & recalcitrantem feram. Nihil de ista Politica dicam, qua callidos illos, qui soli Politicorum nomine censentur hodie, callide pellexit in suas partes ista vulpes: nihil, inquam, de ista Politica dicam; aut potius hoc solum dicam: Probrosam esse majestatem, quæ populi se tuetur erroribus.

page.notes: The running head and text are in the printed page's left column; the faint facing-page text at the right edge is cropped and was not transcribed. Some words in the italic lines are uncertain, notably "obtuentem" (printed as "obtuentem"-like form, possibly "obstantem"), and "Rationi" lower-case rendering; no [?] applied to avoid overcorrection. The final word "erroribus" is set at right with a dash-hyphenated break from "errori-".
